description: Retrieve the complete Google Business Profile by place_id, cid, or hex google_id including 1–5 star rating distribution, E.164 phone, website, categories, weekly work hours, and coordinates. Cost: 20 Credits / place (+20 if enrich_contacts=true and contacts found).

enrich_contacts.description: If true, also crawls the business website domain for B2B emails and social links.

place_id.description: Google Maps Place ID (e.g. "ChIJ..."), numeric CID, or hex feature ID ("0x...:0x...").

name: places_details
title: Get Full Google Business Profile Details
